title: Gifts for gardeners UK 2026: 8 tools they'll use, from £11.91

description: Gifts for gardeners at UK Black Friday prices: Fiskars secateurs £11.91, geared loppers £18.94, Felco 6, Bosch and Ryobi tools and pressure washers.
intro:
**The best gift for a gardener right now is a pair of Fiskars PowerGear L74 geared loppers at £18.94 on Amazon, the lowest price PriceSpy has recorded. Best cheap pick: Fiskars X-series secateurs at £11.91. Best splurge: the Bosch UniversalAquatak 135 pressure washer at £115.95.**

Every price below was read from PriceSpy's Amazon.co.uk listing on 23 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week, so check the product page before you buy. Several of the cordless tools are sold without a battery, which we flag on each card.

deals.name: Fiskars X-series P961 (L) bypass secateurs
deals.note: Our best cheap pick. Sharp, light secateurs with a comfortable grip, at the joint-lowest price PriceSpy has recorded (it has been over £21). A stocking filler any gardener will use.

deals.name: Fiskars PowerGear L74 bypass loppers
deals.note: Geared loppers that cut thicker branches with less effort, which matters for older hands. PriceSpy shows other shops at £42 or more, so this is a strong price.

deals.name: Einhell GE-LS 18 Li-Solo cordless loppers (bare tool)
deals.note: Battery-powered loppers for branches up to about wrist thickness. Bare tool, so it only suits someone who already owns an Einhell Power X-Change battery. Below its previous low; the offer runs to 30 November.

deals.name: Bosch EasyCut 12 cordless pruning saw (bare tool, 06033C9001)
deals.note: A compact powered saw for pruning shrubs and small branches. PriceSpy's earlier range was £85.95 to £119.99, so this is well under its usual price. Needs a Bosch 12V battery and charger.

deals.name: Felco 6 compact secateurs
deals.note: The classic 'forever' secateurs, sized for smaller hands, with replaceable blades and springs. Not a deal: this is the top of its recent range, and specialist shops have had it a few pounds cheaper. Buy it as a gift, not a bargain.

deals.name: Ryobi ONE+ OHT1845 45cm cordless hedge trimmer (bare tool)
deals.note: An easy win for anyone with a Ryobi ONE+ battery already. Same price as Currys, but it has been £76, so it's a fair price rather than a low. No battery included.

deals.name: Kärcher K2 Power Control pressure washer
deals.note: A small, easy-to-store pressure washer for patios, garden furniture and the car. No Black Friday cut: it's just above its three-month range, so only buy if you'd want it at any price.

deals.name: Bosch UniversalAquatak 135 pressure washer with wash brush
deals.note: Our splurge pick: more power than the K2 for bigger patios and decking, and the cheapest of 11 shops on PriceSpy today, close to its recorded low.

body:
## Best gifts for gardeners at a glance

- **Best overall:** Fiskars PowerGear L74 loppers, £18.94 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** Fiskars X-series P961 secateurs, £11.91 at Amazon
- **Best for a serious gardener:** Felco 6 secateurs, £61.18 at Amazon
- **Best splurge:** Bosch UniversalAquatak 135 pressure washer, £115.95 at Amazon
- **Best for someone with a battery already:** Ryobi OHT1845 hedge trimmer, £88.99, or Einhell cordless loppers, £49.99

## How to choose a gift for a gardener

**Hand tools are the safest bet.** Every gardener uses secateurs and loppers, and most are using an old, blunt pair. A good pair of bypass secateurs (the kind with two curved blades that pass each other, like scissors) gives a clean cut that's better for the plant. Anvil secateurs crush rather than cut and are better kept for dead wood.

**Match hand size.** Felco and Fiskars both make smaller sizes. The Felco 6 is the compact version of the famous Felco 2, so it's the better choice for smaller hands. Fiskars' P961 is the larger of its X-series pair.

**Check the battery system before buying power tools.** Most cordless garden tools are sold 'bare', without a battery or charger, which is why they look cheap. Buy only for someone who already owns that brand's batteries: Ryobi ONE+, Bosch 12V or 18V, Einhell Power X-Change. If they don't, a kit with a battery usually costs £40 to £60 more.

**Think about who it's for.** For an older gardener, geared loppers and light tools that reduce strain are the most thoughtful choice. For a new homeowner, a pressure washer for the patio and drive is the gift they won't buy themselves.

**Don't overlook the winter.** A gardener can't do much in December and January, so a gift they can use now goes down well. An audiobook membership is a good one: Audible is [£0.99 a month for three months](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) until 17 December, and it's something to enjoy now and while pottering in spring.

## What's a good price?

These prices are from PriceSpy on 23 November 2026:

- **Secateurs:** £10 to £15 for a reliable Fiskars pair; £50 to £60 for a Felco, which rarely goes on sale
- **Loppers:** under £25 for geared Fiskars loppers (they're usually over £40)
- **Bare cordless pruning tools:** £50 to £60 is a good price
- **Small pressure washers:** around £100 to £120 for a Kärcher K2 or Bosch Aquatak

Big-brand tools and pressure washers usually drop in Black Friday week and again in spring, when garden centres compete for the new season. Hand tools like Felco hold their price all year.

For more ideas, see our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/), including [Christmas gifts for Dad](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-dad-2026/) and [Christmas gifts for grandparents](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-grandparents-uk/).

## FAQs

### What do you buy a gardener who has everything?

Upgrade something they use every week. Most keen gardeners own secateurs, but few own a Felco or a set of geared loppers. If they really have every tool, a pressure washer for the patio is often the one big item missing.

### What is a good cheap gift for a gardener?

The Fiskars X-series secateurs at £11.91 are hard to beat. They're sharp, light and comfortable, and at their lowest recorded price.

### Are Felco secateurs worth the money?

For someone who prunes a lot, yes. They last decades, and every part, from blades to springs, can be replaced. For occasional use, a Fiskars pair does the job for a fraction of the price.

### Do cordless garden tools come with a battery?

Not usually at these prices. All the cordless tools here are 'bare tool' listings, so check the person already owns the same brand's batteries before you buy.

### When should I buy garden tools for Christmas?

Now, if one on this list fits. Several are at their lowest recorded prices this Black Friday week, and Amazon's Black Friday Week ends on Cyber Monday (30 November).
